description: SDM Smart Scatter Plot is a powerful custom visual for Power BI that goes far beyond the built-in scatter chart. Key features: Zoom Inset: In reading mode, select a rectangular area to magnify into a floating zoom window, perfect for exploring dense data regions. Smart Label Placement: Automatic collision-free label positioning with word wrap and configurable alignment. Labels can display series colors as text or background fills. Bubble Sizing: Map a measure to bubble radius for three-dimensional data encoding. Data-Driven Colors: Assign hex color codes per series via a dedicated data well, ensuring consistent branding across reports. Analytics Axes: Add constant X and Y reference lines with customizable styles and labels for benchmarking and threshold visualization. Series Logos: Display Base64-encoded images per series for enhanced branding. Responsive Tooltips: Rich hover tooltips with formatted values for every data point. Nine Languages Supported: English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Italian. Built by Socio Data Management (SDM), data analysis Power BI custom visuals expert.
